resources.string: Pick a folder holding config.json, tokenizer.json, model.q8.gguf (or model.safetensors) and, if it has them, voices/. The files are copied into the app. Then choose Phonon TTS as the preferred engine in the system settings.
Open model page and accept terms
Personal Hugging Face approval required. CC-BY-NC 4.0: non-commercial use only, with attribution. Accept the terms on the model page, then enter your own read token here. No token is saved.
No account needed. English only; this model does not speak German.
Optional personal HF read token (gated models only)
Continues in background. Open app for progress or cancel.

Preview uses this TTS engine. Supported tempo and pitch: 50–200%, independently. First tap initializes voices; tap again to speak. Select a voice matching your text. System apps supply their own rate and pitch.
This is an example of speech synthesis.
Voices loaded. Tap preview again to speak.

Phonon TTS 0.4.1-android.1 · Community fork by Zwiebelrostbraten of gradium-ai/xn-ptts. CPU backend; all synthesis stays offline on this device. Downloads contact Hugging Face only when requested. Same app ID as upstream; different signing key may require uninstalling upstream first (app data will be removed). Android 7+, 64-bit ARM with dotprod/FP16, or x86_64. Runtime on Android has not yet been tested.
